text:
Mercury(II) oxide, HgO, decomposes when heated.
The equation is shown.
2HgO  →  2Hg  +  O2
Why is this a reduction reaction?
A
The products weigh less than the reactants.
B
There are fewer reactants than products.
C
There is a gain of oxygen.
D
There is a loss of oxygen.

options.label: A
options.text: The products weigh less than the reactants.

options.label: B
options.text: There are fewer reactants than products.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a gain of oxygen.

options.label: D
options.text: There is a loss of oxygen.
